step1_analysis.description: A CMOS differential output driver stage, likely a segment of a PAM-4 transmitter. It uses a PMOS and NMOS current-steering architecture to drive a differential load efficiently by switching tail currents.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumed by the driver stage from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming a 10mA tail current to achieve sufficient swing across 50-ohm loads at 1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vswing = 2 * I_tail * R_load = 2 * 10mA * 50 ohm = 1V diff peak (2V peak-to-peak)
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on chosen tail current and load resistor. 10mA and 50 ohms gives 2Vpp diff.

rise_fall_time.description: Transition time of the differential output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by load capacitance and drive strength. For 130nm, ~30ps is typical for 10Gb/s.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 is slightly faster than 180nm, so rise times around 20-40ps are expected.

propagation_delay.description: Delay from 50% of input to 50% of output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard propagation delay for a single stage driver in this node.
Must be >5GHz to support 10Gb/s NRZ/PAM4 signaling.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, swing, rise/fall time, delay, and bandwidth of the PAM-4 driver stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for PAM-4 Transmitter Output Stage
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=50u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=50u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=25u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=25u L_xm4=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 LABEL_NET_4 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Biasing and Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0
VCM VCM 0 0.9

* Tail currents
I_TAIL_P VDD N1 10m
I_TAIL_N N0 GND 10m

* Loads (50 ohm to VCM)
R1 N3 VCM 50
R2 N4 VCM 50

* Inputs (10 Gb/s -> 100ps UI)
V1 LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 50p 20p 20p 80p 200p)
V4 LABEL_NET_4 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 50p 20p 20p 80p 200p)
V2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PULSE(1.8 0 50p 20p 20p 80p 200p)
V3 LABEL_NET_3 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PULSE(1.8 0 50p 20p 20p 80p 200p)

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 100M 100G
  let vout_diff_ac = v(N3) - v(N4)
  let gain_db = vdb(vout_diff_ac)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=100M
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 1n
  let vout_diff = v(N3) - v(N4)
  
  * Measure swing
  meas tran vout_max max vout_diff
  meas tran vout_min min vout_diff
  let swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print swing
  
  * Measure fall time (approx 80% to 20% of the transition)
  meas tran t_fall trig vout_diff val=0.4 fall=1 targ vout_diff val=-0.4 fall=1
  
  * Measure rise time (on the next edge)
  meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff val=-0.4 rise=1 targ vout_diff val=0.4 rise=1
  
  * Measure delay (50% of input to 50% of output)
  meas tran t_delay trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ vout_diff val=0 fall=1
  
  * Measure power
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD)
  let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
  print power
  
  quit
.endc
